title: Sheet Pan Meatball Marinara Feed
seoTitle: Sheet Pan Meatball Marinara Feed | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Oven-baked beef meatballs with marinara for ten
subtitle: Oven-baked beef meatballs with marinara for ten
description: Beef meatballs mix fast, bake on sheet pans until browned, then simmer in marinara until saucy. Serve over spaghetti or in sub rolls for a big crew feed that scales easy.

steps.title: Mix the meatballs
steps.instruction: Combine beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, Parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper until just mixed. Roll into about 60 golf-ball-size meatballs.

steps.title: Bake on sheet pans
steps.instruction: Arrange meatballs on two parchment-lined sheet pans. Bake at 425°F 18–20 minutes until browned and internal temp reaches 160°F. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Simmer in marinara
steps.instruction: Transfer meatballs to large pots, cover with marinara, and simmer 15 minutes until sauce coats meatballs and centers reach 165°F. Target oven/smoker temperature: 165°F.

steps.title: Boil spaghetti
steps.instruction: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente while meatballs simmer. Drain and toss with a ladle of sauce.

steps.title: Serve the spread
steps.instruction: Serve meatballs and sauce over spaghetti with basil. Toast sub rolls with mozzarella for meatball subs on the same line.

proTips: Bake a test meatball first if you are unsure on seasoning—adjust mix before rolling all 60.
Italian seasoning tablespoon in the mix saves chopping extra herbs.
Meatballs freeze raw on sheet pans—transfer to bags for emergency feeds.
tonightSpread: Spaghetti and meatballs with garlic bread and extra Parmesan.
Meatball subs with melted mozzarella for handheld eaters.
leftovers: Meatball parm bake: layer in dish with mozzarella and bake 375°F.
Crush into pizza topping for a quick flatbread night.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Meatballs feed a crowd without carving or portion guesswork. Sheet pan bake beats standing at a skillet forming batches, and subs plus pasta covers different appetites.
mealPrepNotes: Use a scoop for uniform meatballs—they bake evenly. Bake at high heat for color, then finish in sauce. Spaghetti can boil while meatballs bake.
